note: History length in both. The rgmin record defaults to 4 pairs where rgconf defaults to 20.

Factor on the gradient norm in the cautious curvature test. The defaults differ: rgmin uses 1e-4 while the schema and eOn use 1e-6. The rgmin test fixes the exponent at one, while rgconf also exposes it as cautiousAlpha.
Sufficient-decrease constant of the Riemannian line search. rgconf has no line search constant for this method.
Factor applied to a rejected trial length. rgconf has no matching field.
Rejected trials allowed per iteration. The rgconf maxIterLineSearch field applies to the cg method only.
Stop when the gradient norm falls below this fraction of the initial norm. rgconf convergence has no ratio criterion.
ABI record header, not a run parameter.
Reserved ABI word that callers set to zero.
Random-direction pushes before the first Lanczos solve. eOn uses -1 to defer to the pARTn default.
Eigenvalue below which activation starts, in eV per square Angstrom. The rgsaddle default is -0.01 and the schema default is -0.5. The eOn force_threshold is a force criterion, not this value.
Length of each random-direction push in Angstrom. rgsaddle and rgconf default to 0.2 and eOn to 0.3.
Perpendicular relaxation steps after a basin push. rgconf maxPerpRelaxIters is a single limit with no basin and activation split, and the eOn nperp_limitation string is only a loose relative.
Perpendicular relaxation steps after an activation push. See basin_relaxations for why no field is named.
Scale on the projected gradient during relaxation. Neither rgconf nor eOn has this field.
Most Lanczos Hessian actions per geometry. Both rgsaddle and rgconf default to 16. eOn has no matching option.
Lower bound on the absolute eigenvalue in the activation Newton step. Neither rgconf nor eOn has this field.
ABI record header, not a run parameter.
Reserved ABI word.
Nested band configuration. rgconf carries the same group as BandConfig, and eOn spreads it over several fields.
Total image count including both endpoints in rgsaddle and rgconf. eOn counts intermediate images only.
Perpendicular-force threshold for adding a node. The rgsaddle default is 0.2 and the schema default is 0.1. The eOn sidpp_frontier_tol belongs to the IDPP path growth, which is a different method.
Least relaxation steps at the current fragment size before a frontier may add a node. No rgconf or eOn field.
Cap on relaxation steps at the current fragment size, where zero selects the default cap. No rgconf or eOn field.
Frontier distance at which the two fragments join early, where -1 disables the early join. No rgconf or eOn field.
Spline kind used to redistribute nodes. The eOn sidpp_reparam is a boolean for IDPP growth and does not choose a spline.
Norm used for the frontier test and the reported force. rgsaddle offers L2, Linf and max-atom, defaulting to Linf, while the rgconf ForceNorm also has the rms forms.
